computed_with: git show <frame_commit>:<path> | sha256sum, from the repository history
rule: With git history the copy in the frame commit is read and must have this SHA-256 (else the analysis stops). Without git history the working-tree file (or the byte copy named in 'copy', when the working tree differs from the frame commit) is accepted only if its SHA-256 equals this value.

preregistration/rq1/rq1-frame.csv.read_by: analyze.py and explore_disagreement.py (git_show; also frame_sha256 in rq1-sample-manifest.json)

preregistration/rq1/sample_frame.py.read_by: sample_frame.py verify (git); analyze.py checks the working-tree sampler against script_sha256
